name: cardano-tessera-backend
description: Tessera Tier-1 serving backend: the Koios read-path snapshot, cached in SQLite and served over HTTP. Runs as a local Node process now; the same Hono app + a D1 adapter target Cloudflare Workers later.

scripts.migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env preview --remote
scripts.migrate:preprod: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env preprod --remote
scripts.migrate:mainnet: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env mainnet --remote
scripts.deploy:preview: wrangler deploy --env preview --var GIT_COMMIT:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
scripts.deploy:preprod: wrangler deploy --env preprod --var GIT_COMMIT:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
scripts.deploy:mainnet: wrangler deploy --env mainnet --var GIT_COMMIT:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
